steps.code:
# Now we'll process all files: read content, derive title, and create notes.
import os

created_notes = []
for file_path in fs_dir:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_login['access_token'])
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Derive title from filename: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    basename = file_path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    if basename.endswith('.md'):
        basename = basename[:-3]  # remove .md
    title = basename.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note in Simple Note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        title=title,
        content=content,
        access_token=sn_login['access_token']
    )
    print(f"Created note for {file_path}: {result}")
    created_notes.append(result)

print(f"Total notes created: {len(created_notes)}")
